dataset.title: BPA ServiceArea
dataset.description:
BPA Service Area Boundary as defined by legislation and from the following definitions:
BPA service area:     
The geographic area which includes Oregon, Washington, Idaho, Montana west of the Continental Divide, portions of Nevada, Utah, and Wyoming that lie within the Columbia River Basin, and any contiguous areas not more than 75 miles from the above areas of a rural electric cooperative customer served by BPA on the effective date of the Pacific Northwest Power Planning and Conservation Act and whose distribution system serves both within and without the region.

Pacific Northwest:     
According to the Pacific Northwest Electric Power Planning and Conservation Act, Oregon, Washington, Idaho, and Montana west of the Continental Divide, as well as portions of Nevada, Utah, and Wyoming within the Columbia-Snake River Basin.  Also includes contiguous areas not more than 120 kilometers (75 miles) from the region defined above that are part of the service area of rural electric cooperative customers served by BPA on the effective date of the act whose distribution system serves both within and without the region.

dataset.title: BPA Service Area Renewable Generation Sites
dataset.description: Map of existing and proposed renewable generation sites in the Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) Service Area that have some interconnection to the BPA Transmission grid. Sites are depicted as general point locations in the vicinity of the facility site. Due to the expansive nature of wind and other renewable generation facilities, these points should be interpreted and used for general reference only. Renewable generation facilities are privately owned and BPA cannot validate the accuracy or completeness of the facility attributes listed.

dataset.title: Bonneville Power Administration Cadastral Control - Montana
dataset.description: The purpose of this map is to provide historical records of PLSS monuments recovered by Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) field crews in the BPA service area. Land surveyors may use this as a reference only for research purposes. Coordinate values are not to be used as absolute locations; they were obtained by one of three methods: 1) field surveyed values from 2010-present, 2) record locations from BPA maps, 3) GCDB coordinate values. This map was developed by land surveyors at BPA. Please submit any errors found to the site administrator. These values are to be used as search coordinates only and not held for actual positional values.
dataset.license: All information contained herein shall be used for reference purposes only.

dataset.title: Wildfire Activity in the BPA Service Area
dataset.description: Current Wildfire Activity within BPA Service Area, showing BPA Customers and Tribal Boundaries, 2025.  Fire information is provided by ESRI service utilizing IRWIN fire starts and NIFC fire perimeters along with Northwest Inter-agency Coordination Center services.  Tribal Lands comes from the BIA American Indian Reservation dataset, which is a representation of Indian Land.  There are likely minor edits and updates that have occurred since 2005 that are not reflected in this data.  Its use should be confined to general reference purposes only and by no means should it be used for engineering applications to define boundaries.  For official tribal boundaries contact BIA directly.
